verdict.rationale: Unreal Engine is a platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question. A probe found no official Epic MCP server (GitHub search `mcp org:EpicGames` returned 0 results). The only MCP servers found are unofficial community projects that have gone unmaintained, and the Remote Control HTTP/WebSocket API is a developer building block, not an MCP server, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
